name: Reliance Jamnagar AI-enabled data centre for Meta
summary: Reliance Industries agreed in June 2026 to develop a 168 MW AI-enabled data centre in Jamnagar, Gujarat, built to suit Meta, which will lease capacity there to support its global infrastructure and AI compute. Reliance is to handle design, construction, utilities, renewable power, network connectivity and managed operations, with delivery targeted within two years and an option to expand. The facility is to be cooled with desalinated seawater. Reliance described it as Meta's first built-to-suit data centre capacity in India.
